paper_metadata.title: Suppressing temperature-dependent embrittlement in high-strength medium-entropy alloy via hetero-grain/precipitation engineering

evidence.quote: Partial recrystallization and L12 nanoprecipitation were simultaneously introduced into a CoCrNi-based medium entropy alloy, resulting in a heterogeneous microstructure.
